===Emotes=== :''See also: [[Multiplayer/Emotes]]'' The following emotes are available by pressing {{key|Y}}: Emote Angry.png Emote Exclamation.png Emote Game.png Emote Happy.png Emote Heart.png Emote Hi!.gif Emote Laugh.gif Emote No.gif Emote Note.png Emote Pause.png Emote Question.png Emote Sad.png Emote Sick.gif Emote Sleep.png Emote Surprised.gif Emote Uh.gif Emote X.png Emote Yes.gif ===Tips=== *Shift + left-click an inventory item/stack to move it to the top row. *Shift + left-click to continuously purchase items inside a shop/merchant's inventory window. *Shift + left-click to craft 5 items at a time inside the crafting menu. **Hold Ctrl + Shift to craft stacks of 25 items at a time. *Shift + right-click to purchase 5 items. Hold Shift + right-click to keep purchasing items 5 at a time. **Hold Ctrl + Shift to purchase stacks of 25 items at a time. **Hold Ctrl + Shift + 1 to purchase stacks of 999 items at a time. *Right-click a stack of inventory/[[chest]] items to single out one of them. *Shift + right-click to select half a stack of inventory/[[chest]] items. *Hold right-click or left-click while moving the mouse over a group of equipment (''e.g.,'' [[Keg]]s, [[Preserves Jar]]s, [[Cask]]s, [[Bee House]]s) to collect items quickly. **Have another item selected in inventory to refill equipment automatically. **If the item is edible, you must use left-click, or the game will ask if you want to consume the item. *Delete to permanently delete a selected item in the inventory window. (Use {{key|E}}/{{key|Escape}} to open inventory, then Left-click on an item/stack to select it, then press the delete key.) *Pressing the Esc key while on the opening splash screen takes you directly to the main menu select screen. *When viewing a dialogue box with a "yes/no" answer, pressing {{key|E}}/{{key|Escape}} or {{key|N}} indicates "no", and pressing the {{key|Y}} key indicates "yes". *Shift + left-click on an item in the [[Catalogue]] or [[Furniture Catalogue]] to add it directly to inventory, instead of attaching it to the mouse cursor. This also works when removing items from the Grange Display at the [[Stardew Valley Fair]]. *Rebind the chat box key to avoid opening it accidentally, or temporarily enter screenshot mode with {{key|F4}} to place objects at the bottom left of the screen. == Xbox One / Xbox 360 Controller == Controller buttons can not be reassigned. ===In Overworld=== {|class="wikitable" style="width:500px;" ! style="width:180px;" | '''Button''' ! style="width:320px;" | '''Description''' |- | style="text-align:center; font-size:18px;" | [[File:360 Left Stick.png|40px]]

Square | style="padding-left: 1.0em" | Move One Item / Use Item (bait, etc.) |} ===Controller Map=== [[File:PS4ControllerMap.png]] ===Advanced Controls=== * '''With a shop menu open''': ** Hold [[File:PS4 Square.png|24px|link=]] and [[File:PS4 Cross.png|24px|link=]] to purchase items in bulk at a much faster rate and drastically speed up the buying process * '''With the inventory menu open''': ** Press the [[File:PS4 Touch Pad.png|24px|link=]] Touchpad button to automatically sort the items. ** Press [[File:PS4 Circle.png|24px|link=]] after selecting an item, and the cursor will automatically hover over the trash icon. * '''When interacting with a''' [[chest]]: ** Press [[File:PS4 R1.png|24px|link=]] to quickly jump to the ''Add to Existing Stacks'' icon. (This will automatically pull any items from your inventory which already have a stack in the chest’s storage.) * '''Placing / rotating [[furniture]]''': ** Press [[File:PS4 Square.png|24px|link=]] while facing towards and in contact with the item to select it. ** Press [[File:PS4 Cross.png|24px|link=]] to rotate a selected item. **: Note, ''not all items have this capability''. For example, the [[farmhouse#Interior|default house]] has a [[furniture#Beds|bed]] which cannot be rotated, a [[furniture#Rugs|rug]] which can rotate by 180°, and a [[furniture#Chairs|chair]] which can rotate by 90 °. ==Switch Controller== Controller buttons can be reassigned systemwide in System Settings > Controllers and Sensors > Change Button Mapping. ===In Overworld=== {|class="wikitable" style="width:500px;" ! style="width:180px;" | '''Button''' ! style="width:320px;" | '''Description''' |- | style="text-align:center; font-size:18px;" | [[File:Switch Left Stick.png|40px]]

+ Button | style="padding-left: 1.0em" | Exit Menu |- | style="text-align:center; font-size:18px;" | [[File:Switch LT.png|40px]]ZL [[File:Switch RT.png|40px]]ZR | style="padding-left: 1.0em" | Switch Menu Tab |- | style="text-align:center; font-size:18px;" | [[File:Switch Y.png|40px]]Y | style="padding-left: 1.0em" | Move One Item / Use Item (bait, etc.) |} ===Controller Map=== [[File:SwitchControllerMap.png]] ===Object Placement Tips=== *One of the most useful controls is the [[File:Switch Right Stick.png|24px|link=]] '''Right Stick'''. It can be used to exactly place furniture, rugs, windows, etc. where you want them. It's pretty sensitive but is very useful especially for placing wall furniture such as paintings and windows. *While moving a rug into place using the [[File:Switch Right Stick.png|24px|link=]] '''Right Stick''', use [[File:Switch A.png|24px|link=]] to ''Rotate'' the rug. ===Toolbar Tips=== *To "power-up" tools such as the [[Watering Cans|Watering Can]] (''i.e.,'' act on multiple tiles at once), press and hold [[File:Switch Y.png|24px|link=]]. *Interacting with villagers with any item other than tools will gift that item to the villager. ===Inventory Tips=== *When moving inventory, the [[File:Switch Y.png|24px|link=]] button will move one item at a time or hold to move multiple. *Pressing [[File:Switch B.png|24px|link=]] after selecting an item(s) from your inventory will move it to the trash icon. *Pressing [[File:Switch Minus.png|24px|link=]] while in your inventory will quickly organize items. *Pressing both [[File:Switch A.png|24px|link=]] and [[File:Switch Y.png|24px|link=]] while purchasing items from any shop will allow the player to purchase items twice as fast. ===Weapons=== *Pressing [[File:Switch Y.png|24px|link=]] performs basic attack while pressing [[File:Switch A.png|24px|link=]] performs block or alternate attack. ===Nintendo Switch 2 Mouse Controls=== The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Stardew Valley supports optional mouse controls. When these are enabled, the right Joy Con can be used as a mouse to move the cursor around. During gameplay, use: * The '''R''' button to pick up furniture or use a tool * The '''ZR''' button to rotate furniture, interact with the environment, or use other items * The '''R Stick''' to scroll through the toolbar. By default, moving the R Stick down scrolls to the ''right''. This can be reversed by checking the Invert Toolbar Scroll Direction box in the [[Options]] menu. In the inventory, use: * The '''R''' button to pick up or drop an entire stack of items * The '''ZR''' button to pick up or drop a single item from a stack Mouse controls can be disabled entirely in the [[Options]] menu. ==History== {{History|1.4|Removed "new" input from button press until the button is released. This makes harvesting large numbers of kegs/preserves jars/crystalariums, etc. easier by holding the button without releasing it. Added option to shift toolbar (active inventory bar) to PC. Added emotes menu.}} {{History|1.5.5|Holding Control + Shift now lets you purchase or craft stacks of 25 items at a time.}} {{History|1.6|Holding Control + Shift + 1 now lets you purchase stacks of 999 items at a time.}} [[Category:Gameplay]] [[de:Steuerung]] [[es:Controles]] [[fr:Commandes]] [[it:Controlli]] [[ja:操作方法]] [[ko:조작]] [[hu:Irányítás]] [[pt:Controles]] [[ru:Управление]] [[tr:Kontroller]] [[zh:控制]]
